blocks.text: Koi organic compound banana shuru karne se pehle chemical reactions, reagents (react karane wale maadde) aur har qadam (step) mukammal karne ke liye zaroori conditions (halaat) samajhna zaroori hai, taa ke target molecule yaqeeni tor par ban jaye.

Zyada tar organic compounds kai mukhtalif raaston (routes) se ban sakte hain, aur behtareen raasta chunne ke liye kuch mayaar (criteria) chahiye. Kisi cheez ki achhi synthesis woh hai jo saste aur aasani se milne wale starting materials (shuruati maadde) ko aise raaste se matloob product mein badle jis mein kam se kam steps hon aur overall yield (kul hasil hone wali miqdar) zyada ho.

Organic synthesis mein kaam aane wale bohat se organic reactions maloom hain. Inhein do qism mein baanta ja sakta hai: ya to yeh functional group interconversion (FGI, yani aik functional group ko doosre mein badalna) karte hain, ya carbon-carbon bond banate hain. Carbon-carbon bond banane wale reactions khaas tor par ahem hain, kyun ke synthesis ki bunyadi strategy (hikmat-e-amali) yeh hai ke target molecule ko saada aur chhote starting materials ko jor kar banaya jaye.

blocks.prompt: Achhi synthesis ka raasta kaisa hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Starting materials saste aur aasani se milne wale hon, steps kam se kam hon aur overall yield zyada ho.

items: Har step ka reaction, reagent aur conditions pehle samjhein.
Behtareen raasta: saste starting materials, kam steps, zyada overall yield.
Synthesis ke reactions do qism ke: FGI ya carbon-carbon bond banana.
